offering_description.value: Artisan Partners manages active equity, fixed-income and alternative investment strategies for institutions, financial intermediaries and individual investors. Its investment teams research and select investments for separately managed accounts and pooled funds.

primary_products.value: Mutual funds; UCITS funds; collective investment trusts; private investment funds

primary_services.value: Discretionary portfolio management for separately managed accounts; pooled fund management

customer_segment.value: B2B: Corporate pension plans, endowments, foundations, financial advisers and wealth managers; B2C: Individual investors who buy fund shares; B2G: Public pension plans and other government investment institutions

end_markets.value: Institutional investing; retirement and pensions; wealth management; retail investing

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: Asset-based fees for managing accounts and funds, plus performance fees on certain mandates

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Manages client assets under investment mandates for institutional and intermediary clients; financial intermediary: Pools investor capital in funds offered to institutional and individual investors

geography_served.value: global: United States and international markets, including Europe and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Active equity, fixed-income and alternative investment strategies

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Institutional client teams and direct fund accounts; partners / resellers: Financial advisers, wealth managers and investment platforms

regulatory_exposure.value: high: SEC investment adviser registration and fund oversight, plus European UCITS rules for relevant funds
